knowledge_gaps: Training-prefix targets may already have been used to fit the checkpoint. Withholding them from diagnostic inputs prevents direct input leakage but does not make them held-out evaluation examples. These probes measure training-history dependence; claims about generalization require separate host validation evidence.

Intervention construction is underspecified: deleting before truncation can introduce older interactions absent from the baseline input. Define the baseline visible window first, deletion sizes, minimum history length, permutation rules, random repetitions, candidate count, tie handling and bootstrap procedure. Report positional changes and no-op interventions.

Skipping positions merely because the positive item is visible can incorrectly reject legitimate BERT4Rec unchanged-token masking cases or repeated historical items. Distinguish selected prediction positions, corruption policy and accidental shifted-target exposure; report genuinely concealed-target diagnostics separately.

The proposed candidate scoring call assumes broadcasting behavior not established by the ModelView contract. Specify supported tensor shapes, real-item and mask IDs, maximum sequence length, batched candidate scoring and inference parity checks. Category aggregation also needs an explicit orchestration step because each probe receives one category model.

The probe does not operationalize the simulator feedback signals about immediate choice, deferral, explicit mismatch and unidentified items. Track those only when recorded feedback supports them. Sampled-candidate top-10 overlap must also be distinguished from the required full-catalog recommendations.

Originality 5 and potential 8 are optimistic for an unvalidated diagnostic synthesis; difficulty 4 depends on missing interface and orchestration details. Prioritize inference correctness checks before expanding interventions, and specify a bounded diagnostic runtime within the shared GPU budget.
